premise: Hedgehog rolls in leaves to look grand for the leaf parade and ends up a leaf ball; Mouse and Squirrel unpick him and everyone wears one leaf.
inspiration: The Jackdaw in Borrowed Feathers (Aesop), turned: nobody laughs at the one who overdressed; friends unpick him and share the costume.
lesson: You are grand enough as you are, and friends share the finery.

en-US.title: Hedgehog's Leaf Coat
en-US.text: It was the day of the leaf parade, and Hedgehog {hedgehog:pulse} wanted to look grand. Very, very grand. So he rolled in the biggest pile of leaves under the {tree:wobble} tree. {sfx:leaves solo} Roll, roll, roll. When he stood up, he was not a hedgehog any more. He was a leaf ball. [giggles] Hedgehog? said Mouse. {mouse:hop} I am very grand, said the leaf ball, and tried to walk. {hedgehog:wobble x3} Wibble. Wobble. Flump. Squirrel {squirrel:hop x2} and Mouse came running. Do not laugh, said Hedgehog. [softly] Nobody laughed. They plucked. One leaf, {hedgehog:shake 0.5} two leaves, ten leaves, a hundred leaves, until Hedgehog's nose poked out. [surprised] Oh, said Hedgehog. There is a lot of me. Then Mouse put one red leaf on his own head. Squirrel took a yellow one. Hedgehog kept one gold one, on his tallest prickle. {hedgehog:sparkle} [happily] And the three grandest friends in the forest walked to the parade together.

es-ES.title: El abrigo de hojas de Erizo
es-ES.text: Era el día del desfile de las hojas, y Erizo {hedgehog:pulse} quería estar elegante. Muy, muy elegante. Así que se revolcó en el montón de hojas más grande, debajo del {tree:wobble} árbol. {sfx:leaves solo} Vuelta, vuelta, vuelta. Cuando se levantó, ya no era un erizo. Era una bola de hojas. [giggles] ¿Erizo?, dijo Ratón. {mouse:hop} Estoy muy elegante, dijo la bola de hojas, e intentó andar. {hedgehog:wobble x3} Tambaleo. Bamboleo. Plof. Ardilla {squirrel:hop x2} y Ratón llegaron corriendo. No os riais, dijo Erizo. [softly] Nadie se rio. Fueron quitando hojas. Una hoja, {hedgehog:shake 0.5} dos hojas, diez hojas, cien hojas, hasta que asomó la nariz de Erizo. [surprised] Oh, dijo Erizo. Hay mucho erizo aquí dentro. Entonces Ratón se puso una hoja roja en la cabeza. Ardilla cogió una amarilla. Erizo se quedó una dorada, en su púa más alta. {hedgehog:sparkle} [happily] Y los tres amigos más elegantes del bosque se fueron juntos al desfile.

leaves.prompt: a small animal rolling over and over in a crunchy pile of dry autumn leaves, rustle and crackle
